svg.title: Food production worker — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as food production worker, wearing an apron and a hair covering. Visible work cue: A food tray carrying a rounded loaf passes through a processing arch above a conveyor belt. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a hair covering.
